import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    payments = inputs["payments"].copy()
    
    # Initialize columns for tracking
    payments["_reason_code"] = None
    payments["_rejected"] = False
    
    # R1: amount IS NULL -> reason_code 'AMT_NULL'
    mask_r1 = payments["amount"].isna()
    payments.loc[mask_r1 & ~payments["_rejected"], "_reason_code"] = "AMT_NULL"
    payments.loc[mask_r1 & ~payments["_rejected"], "_rejected"] = True
    
    # R2: amount <= 0 -> reason_code 'AMT_NONPOS'
    mask_r2 = (payments["amount"] <= 0) & (payments["amount"].notna())
    payments.loc[mask_r2 & ~payments["_rejected"], "_reason_code"] = "AMT_NONPOS"
    payments.loc[mask_r2 & ~payments["_rejected"], "_rejected"] = True
    
    # R3: currency NOT IN ('USD','EUR','GBP') -> reason_code 'CCY_INVALID'
    mask_r3 = ~payments["currency"].isin(["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
    payments.loc[mask_r3 & ~payments["_rejected"], "_reason_code"] = "CCY_INVALID"
    payments.loc[mask_r3 & ~payments["_rejected"], "_rejected"] = True
    
    # R4: country IS NULL -> reason_code 'CTRY_NULL'
    mask_r4 = payments["country"].isna()
    payments.loc[mask_r4 & ~payments["_rejected"], "_reason_code"] = "CTRY_NULL"
    payments.loc[mask_r4 & ~payments["_rejected"], "_rejected"] = True
    
    # Split into clean and reject
    clean = payments[~payments["_rejected"]].copy()
    rejects = payments[payments["_rejected"]].copy()
    
    # Build output for clean records
    payments_clean = clean[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country"]].copy()
    payments_clean["amount"] = payments_clean["amount"].round(2)
    
    # Build output for rejected records
    payments_rejects = rejects[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country", "_reason_code"]].copy()
    payments_rejects = payments_rejects.rename(columns={"_reason_code": "reason_code"})
    
    return {
        "payments_clean": payments_clean,
        "payments_rejects": payments_rejects
    }
